title: Tesla Coil Robot Dream
description: A glowing plasma globe sits on a wooden desk with papers and sketches, its central orange orb emitting colorful looping energy streams in pink, yellow, green, and blue. Inside the transparent sphere, a small blue robot with a wide grin stands beside a silhouette of a person and a floating East Asian pagoda.
prompt: A surreal painting of a vintage Tesla coil plasma globe on a wooden desk covered in robot and pagoda sketches. Inside the glowing glass sphere, a small cute blue robot with big eyes stands next to a human silhouette and a floating multi-tiered East Asian pagoda. Bright colorful plasma tendrils in pink, yellow, green and blue loop dramatically around the central orange orb. Dark moody background with glass display domes on shelves. Cinematic lighting with vibrant neon reflections.
